Overview

Sheboygan is a city in WI with a population of 48,000. Lake Michigan city known as the Bratwurst Capital with the Bookworm Gardens. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees.
